question: Can a cheap14pathway public basal context predict directly measured high-dose mono viability for a held-out cell, without paired full multimodal or combination records?
labels: Historical111cells only. One high-dose library mono response per cell,drug,top-dose range; average source events within cell. No fitted IC50 and no target14 mono/combination outcomes.
inputs: Drug registry ID, actual uM top dose, tissue and14published basal RNA-derived pathway footprints. Footprints are cell-line reference covariates, not directly measured signaling activity or target culture state.
split: Five complete-cell folds stratified by tissue, sorted SIDMs shuffled seed20261007. All doses,drugs and source events of one cell stay in one fold.
methods: tissue historical drug+exact-dose mean with global fallback
same tissue baseline plus drug+exact-dose conditional ridge on context
same ridge with context mapping permuted within tissue
ridge: Fixed lambda10 for summed squared loss, training-only per-key standardization and residual centering. No outcome-based lambda or feature selection. Conditional model requires >=10 training cells, otherwise tissue fallback. Point estimates not clipped or renamed mechanism probabilities.
primary_metric: Per-cell mean absolute error across measured drugs/doses, then average cells; RMSE secondary. Compare to strongest simple tissue baseline. Report by tissue and support range.
model_outputs: Held-out predictions with fold and source support, plus reference predictions for target14cells with explicit no-target-measurement training declaration. No target outcomes used to assess these reference predictions.
agent_role: Agent evaluates source coverage, dose/time/identity compatibility and chooses retrieve/transport/fallback actions. The current execution is deterministic tool use, not an LLM-agent gain test. Real action costs and shared tool budgets must be registered before an agent versus deterministic comparison.
claim_boundaries: Same-screen public mono response forecasting only; not new-drug generalization, independent culture validation, combination synergy, mechanistic causal inference or confirmed discovery benefit. A positive forecasting result licenses further ranking evaluation, not production activation.
preservation: Original acquisition contract and prior experiments unchanged; new outputs refuse overwrite.
